title: deploy-quarto-on-render
text:
Initial setup

Install Quarto CLI.
Install Quarto VS Code Extension.
Create a new repository on GitHub (e.g., https://github.com/gvelasq/deploy-quarto-on-render).
Clone the GitHub repository: Git: Clone > https://github.com/gvelasq/deploy-quarto-on-render.
Create a Quarto project: Quarto: Create Project > Website Project.
In the Finder popup window, choose the project root folder deploy-quarto-on-render then click Choose Project Directory.
In the Command Palette popup window, for Project Directory Name type . to add the project files to the project root folder. This will add _quarto.yml, .gitignore, about.qmd, index.qmd, and styles.css to the project root folder.
Add site navigation with auto generation of sidebar contents. In _quarto.yml, add the following under website: with two-space indentation:

website:
  sidebar:
    contents: auto
  # rest of _quarto.yml contents below

Render the Quarto project: Quarto: Render Project.
Commit and push the ./_site folder.
Sign into Render with your GitHub account.
Select New Static Site > Credentials > Configure in GitHub.
In the browser popup window, select your GitHub username.
Select Only selected repositories > gvelasq/deploy-quarto-on-render > Install.
Back in Render’s dialog for New Static Site, select Git Provider > gvelasq/deploy-quarto-on-render.
Change Name if desired. Set Publish Directory to _site.
Select Deploy Static Site.
In the Render dashboard, the virtual console will exit with ==> Your site is live 🎉 and the new static site will be available at the corresponding URL (e.g., https://deploy-quarto-on-render.onrender.com).

title: deploy-quarto-on-render
text:
Add a linked page

In the project root folder, duplicate about.qmd and rename it chapter01.qmd. Replace its contents with:

---
title: "Chapter 1"
---

This chapter links to the [about](about.qmd) page.

Render the Quarto project: Quarto: Render Project.
Commit and push the new page.
The Chapter 1 page links back to the About page.
